statement: No code path in tezgah calls TypeSafe; the only TypeSafe code in the tree is the health probe have_typesafe_key().
falsification: a caller of api.typesafe.ai resolves anywhere in hooks/, bin/ or hosts/.

statement: The TypeSafe credential is resolvable from ~/.config/typesafe/key but absent from a non-login shell's environment, so any hook needs the file fallback.
falsification: a non-login, non-interactive shell on this machine shows TYPESAFE_API_KEY set.

statement: One admin screen read through the pinned Playwright MCP costs about 3,701 tokens (14,805 chars), and a two-screen flow about 3,985.
falsification: a repeat measurement of the same fixture screen returns under 2,000 tokens or over 6,000.

statement: TypeSafe's published economics are $0.042 per 1M input tokens with $0 output, and batching 13 questions into one call is 12.2x cheaper and 10.0x faster with identical answers.
falsification: the vendor's cookbook or the pricing page states a different price, or a batched call's answers differ from the same questions asked singly.

statement: The highest-value first TypeSafe surface is a prompt-time skill suggestion, because it deletes most of the 2,019-character-per-session roster from the always-on text and the vendor measured wrong loads halving.
falsification: the roster cannot be shrunk without breaking the opencode router path, or wrong skill loads rise in a paired run.

statement: A TypeSafe tree triage keeps at least 95% of the load-bearing controls while the agent reads at most 30% of the tree's lines.
falsification: recall below 95% of the load-bearing controls, or the agent still reading more than 30% of the lines on the measured fixture screens.

statement: The first triage shape (one noul per snapshot line at a 0.5 threshold) selects 26% of a 356-line screen but recalls only 69.9% of its load-bearing controls, so P1's 95% floor does not hold.
falsification: a repeat on the same fixture with the same shape returns recall >= 95%, or the 25 missed controls turn out not to be load-bearing for the task.

statement: Compacting the 13 skill descriptions to name plus one clause saves the full ~1,516 tokens but costs measured skill-choice quality, so the roster stays at its full descriptions.
falsification: a repeat on the same labelled prompt set where the compact arm's wrong-load count is not above the full arm's.

statement: The highest-value first TypeSafe surface is a prompt-time skill suggestion, because it deletes most of the 8,019-character-per-session roster from the always-on text and the vendor measured wrong loads halving.
falsification: the roster cannot be shrunk without breaking the opencode router path, or wrong skill loads rise in a paired run.

statement: Code in tezgah now calls TypeSafe: hooks/tezgah_judge.py is the seam and hooks/tezgah_skill_pick.py, bin/tezgah-triage and bin/tezgah-docs are its callers, so the claim that the only TypeSafe code in the tree is the health probe have_typesafe_key() no longer holds.

statement: TypeSafe published economics - $0.042 per 1M input tokens with $0 output, and batching 13 questions into one call 12.2x cheaper and 10.0x faster - are a quoted secondary source this line holds no note for, so they are recorded as read but not re-openable from the line, and the price is now pinned in the repository own triage tool.
falsification: the vendor price page states a different price, or a batched call answers differently from the same questions asked singly

statement: The prompt-time skill suggestion is now built as hooks/tezgah_skill_pick.py, and it did not shrink the always-on roster: the roster measures 9,168 chars over 14 skills today, and the line own four-arm measurement left the hint no headroom, so ranking it the highest-value first surface is withdrawn and the picker ships opt-in instead.

statement: The shipped triage shape keeps 100% of the 83 control lines at a 94% read, so the read half of P1 - at most 0.3 of the lines - does not hold: 79% of that screen lines sit inside the rows the task names, which floors any selection keeping 95% of the controls at a 76% read, and the per-line shape the claim assumed is the one that failed at 73.5% recall.
